capabilities: Assign Lucide icons to files and folders
Set a custom color per icon
Apply text and background colors to explorer file names
Preview color changes live before applying
Remove icons individually or reset all from Settings
extras: Ships with English and French translations; other languages can be added by translating i18n/en.json.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no built-in way to visually distinguish individual files and folders with icons or colors.
summary: File and folder decoration plugin that assigns Lucide icons and custom text or background colors via the explorer right-click menu.
